input_reference: Second attempts used a visibility-only 1024x1024 Lanczos enlargement of each exact 128x128 original from expanded/original. The enlarged references are in ignored build/{id}-target-reference.png and are reproducible with Pillow Image.resize((1024,1024),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS). No detail was manually synthesized.

registration: jobs-rgb565-b.json contains half-open source logical and generated raw rectangles, one for the dial and one for lower housing. Measured original islands and private review established their geometry. Raw is unmodified; importer can replay registration. Preview code in build/clocks_b_preview.py is only a private reproduction of uv_regions.
